summary.headline: Astrological Catalog Entries 634–645
summary.text: Catalog entries 634–645 cover methods for finding lots, Theophilus on beginnings, the lord of the year and month, conjunctions and full moons, eclipse outcomes, rains, harmed Moon and stars, planetary indications in zodiacal signs, lunar transits, and sailing. Added entries describe horoscoping zodiacal signs, the decans and bounds beginning from Pisces, and outcomes attributed to Paul of Heliodorus and other astrologers.
